title: Crăciun la Brașov
description: Christmas evening by a crackling fireplace in a Romanian home, with snowy Brașov, the Tâmpa and the Black Church through the window, and a "Crăciun fericit" card on the mantel. Warm fire, walnut and cream, serif type.
